title: Collaborative Language Models for Semantic IoT Data Processing: Validation through Zero-Shot Human Activity Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.33411v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) systems generate low-level sensor observations that are not directly suitable for process analysis and must first be transformed into semantically meaningful events. This paper investigates collaborative language models as a zero-shot semantic abstraction layer for converting such observations into higher-level event and activity labels. We propose a five-stage workflow comprising semantic mapping, semantic aggregation, temporal and contextual aggregation, specialized reasoning, and final event abstraction. The resulting labels and contextual information can subsequently be represented as event records for downstream Process Mining (PM) tasks. The approach is evaluated through Human Activity Recognition on the CASAS Aruba smart home dataset using eleven workflow configurations. translated_title: 面向语义物联网数据处理的协作式语言模型：通过零样本人类活动识别进行验证
translated_abstract: 物联网系统生成的底层传感器观测数据并不直接适用于流程分析，必须首先转换为具有语义意义的事件。本文研究了协作式语言模型作为一种零样本语义抽象层，用于将此类观测数据转换为更高层次的事件和活动标签。我们提出了一个包含五个阶段的工作流程，包括语义映射、语义聚合、时间与上下文聚合、专门推理以及最终的事件抽象。所得到的标签和上下文信息随后可以表示为事件记录，用于下游的流程挖掘（PM）任务。该方法通过在CASAS Aruba智能家居数据集上使用十一种工作流程配置进行人类活动识别来评估。实验表明，仅靠协作并不能保证性能提升：通用辅助小型语言模型（SLM）可能会降低识别性能。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于协作式语言模型的五阶段零样本语义抽象工作流程，可将物联网底层传感器观测转换为高层事件标签以支持流程挖掘，并通过CASAS Aruba智能家居数据集上的人类活动识别验证了其可行性，同时发现协作本身并不必然带来性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a five-stage zero-shot semantic abstraction workflow using collaborative language models to transform low-level IoT sensor observations into high-level event labels for downstream process mining, validated through human activity recognition on the CASAS Aruba smart home dataset, showing that collaboration alone does not guarantee improved performance.
